description: This file contains test cases for various functions related to Telegram inline buttons, including building approval buttons, resolving chat types, constructing interactive buttons, and resolving inline buttons. It uses the Vitest testing framework and references multiple internal modules for implementation.

methods.name: buildTelegramExecApprovalButtons
methods.description: Builds approval buttons with options 'Allow Once', 'Allow Always', and 'Deny', with callback data formatted for Telegram interactions.

methods.name: resolveTelegramTargetChatType
methods.description: Determines the type of Telegram chat based on input string, identifying direct, group, or unknown chat types.

methods.name: buildTelegramInteractiveButtons
methods.description: Converts shared button definitions and select options into Telegram inline button layouts, handling length limits and callback data rewriting.

methods.name: resolveTelegramInlineButtons
methods.description: Resolves which set of inline buttons to use, prioritizing explicit button arrays, or deriving from an interactive payload.

ctags.name: explicit
ctags.pattern: /^    const explicit = [[{ text: "Keep", callback_data: "keep" }]] as const;$/
